zh.title: 空中巴士7月交付67架新機 受到發動機短缺與供應鏈干擾
zh.summary: 根據Simple Flying報導，空中巴士於2026年7月交付67架新飛機，交機數量低於達成年度目標所需的月平均水準。受限於供應鏈瓶頸與發動機短缺問題，空中巴士生產進度持續受到挑戰，相關團隊正全力清理積壓的訂單，並維持全年交付870架飛機的目標。
body: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，空中巴士於2026年7月共交付67架新飛機。該月交付數量低於達成年度交付目標所需的月平均水準，反映出目前交機進度面臨顯著壓力。
供應鏈遭遇瓶頸以及發動機供應短缺，持續對空中巴士的生產線造成影響。生產團隊目前正在全力進行相關作業，設法加速清理持續累積的飛機交付積壓訂單。
根據歷史統計紀錄，空中巴士在2026年第二季共完成了237架飛機的交付，目前仍持續維持全年交付870架飛機的目標。

en.title: Airbus Delivers 67 Aircraft in July Amid Supply Chain and Engine Shortages
en.summary: According to Simple Flying, Airbus delivered 67 new aircraft in July 2026, remaining below the monthly delivery average required to achieve its annual targets. Production operations continue to be stretched by supply chain disruption and engine shortages, as assembly teams work to process a growing backlog of unfulfilled aircraft orders. Historically, Airbus achieved 237 deliveries during the second quarter and has maintained its target of delivering 870 aircraft for the full year.
body: According to reporting by Simple Flying, Airbus delivered 67 new aircraft during July 2026. This monthly delivery figure remains below the monthly average necessary for the commercial aircraft manufacturer to satisfy its full-year delivery target.

Production operations continue to be stretched by ongoing global supply chain disruptions and severe shortages of engine components. Dedicated assembly teams across Airbus are working to clear an expanding backlog of unfulfilled customer deliveries.
Historical context records indicate that Airbus completed 237 aircraft deliveries in the second quarter of 2026, while officially maintaining its annual target of delivering 870 aircraft.
